title: fix(app-shell): the Studio Interfaces rail draws the server's localized nav labels (objectui#12688)
body:
Fixes #12688
Clause-②: no

## What

On a zh-CN session the Studio drew two surfaces in the authored English, while the runtime on the same session drew the translated text:

- the **Interfaces rail** (heading, group headings and rows);
- the dashboard property panel's **component list**.

This PR fixes both. Both now draw what the server's `/meta` boundary already localized. Every editor keeps the authored text.

## Mechanism (measured on a real console)

- **Rail.** The rail drew the nav editor's buffer: the app's pending draft, else `GET /api/v1/meta/app/showcase_app/layers`, the authored code layer. On zh-CN that read answers `Capability Map`. The pillar's app load already sends `GET /api/v1/meta/app?package=com.example.showcase` with the session's `Accept-Language`, and the server answers it through `translateApp`: 功能展示, and 能力地图 / 页面搭建 / 工作区 / 数据模型 / 图表画廊.
- **Component list.** The list drew the dashboard leaf's buffer: its draft, else `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/showcase_chart_gallery/layers`, which answers `Task Count vs Avg Progress`. The console's metadata store already holds `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard`, and the server answers it through `translateDashboard`: 任务数与平均进度 for `combo_count_vs_progress`.
- **Canvas.** The dashboard canvas's 任务数与平均进度 comes from neither read. `DashboardPreview` mounts `DashboardRenderer` without `localized`, so the renderer translates through the client bundle. That pass is unchanged here; see the acceptance notes.

## Fix

**One rule, two surfaces.** The served text is drawn for an entry or widget whose authored text in the buffer equals its text in the published layer. Entries are matched by nav entry `id`, widgets by widget `id`. An entry or widget changed or added in the draft draws its authored text, as before. Both surfaces use one comparison, `sameLabel` in `servedNavText.ts`.

- **Rail: `studio-design/servedNavText.ts`.** It pairs the served app row with the `/layers` effective layer. The rail's rows, group headings and heading draw the resulting display tree. The leaf opened on load is resolved from the same tree, so its caption matches its row.
- **Component list: `studio-design/servedDashboardText.ts`.** It pairs the served dashboard from the metadata store with the published layer.
  - With no pending draft, the published layer is the baseline the leaf load already read.
  - With a pending draft, the pillar reads `/layers` once. It does so only for a dashboard the server serves, so a never-published draft still asks no `/layers` (objectui#11799).
  - The pillar hands the pairing to `DashboardDefaultInspector` through one app-shell-internal context, `ServedWidgetTextContext`. It is not exported from the package root, and no prop or type changes. Outside the Studio pillar the context is empty, and the list reads as it always has.

Every editor keeps reading the authored buffer:

- the nav editor's cards (`AppNavCanvas`);
- the nav-item inspector's Label input and the nav inspector's head;
- a source page's list of nav entries;
- the widget inspector's Title input;
- the canvas's rename strip;
- the component list's selection labels.

There is no second translator: no key is built and no client bundle is read, which follows the `navGroupLabel` docblock in `@object-ui/i18n` ("One owner, not two").

## Readings

Setup: a real console (Vite) against an objectstack `66d456d01` showcase backend, used as a backend only. The session was switched through `PATCH sys_user.locale`, then the console was reloaded, as the card describes.

- **before:** a console from main `2dbe5f5`.
- **after:** a console from this branch's code (`e49639b`; later commits change tests and the changeset only).

| surface | locale | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| rail heading | zh-CN | SHOWCASE · 导航 | 功能展示 · 导航 |
| rail rows | zh-CN | Capability Map · Page Authoring · WORKSPACE · DATA MODEL · … · Chart Gallery | 能力地图 · 页面搭建 · 工作区 · 数据模型 · … · 图表画廊 |
| open leaf's caption | zh-CN | Chart Gallery | 图表画廊 |
| component list, `combo_count_vs_progress` | zh-CN | Task Count vs Avg Progress | 任务数与平均进度 |
| component list, other widgets | zh-CN | Total Tasks · Avg Progress · … | unchanged: the showcase bundle translates only that one widget |
| rail and component list | en-US | Capability Map · … / Task Count vs Avg Progress | identical: 30 of 30 rail lines and 40 of 40 inspector lines read equal |

On zh-CN, the only line of the inspector reading (40 lines) that differs between before and after is the `combo_count_vs_progress` row. The rail's uppercase group headings come from CSS; the DOM text is the label.

## Tests (run on `11191e9`)

New pins:

| file | what it pins |
|---|---|
| `StudioDesignSurface.railServedLabels-12688.test.tsx` | the rail |
| `InterfacesPillar.componentListServedTitles-12688.test.tsx` | the component list, with the real `DashboardDefaultInspector` and `DashboardWidgetInspector` over a metadata store serving the `/meta` dashboard list |
| `servedNavText.test.ts`, `servedDashboardText.test.ts` | the pairing rules; every fixture parses against `AppSchema` / `DashboardSchema` |

**Red on unchanged main.** Each pillar file was run against main's version of the files it covers, then restored from `HEAD`. The restore was proven by blob equality and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| pillar file | result on main | why it is red |
|---|---|---|
| rail | 4 failed, 2 passed | `Unable to find an element with the text: 能力地图` |
| component list | 3 failed, 2 passed | the zh list reads `Total Tasks …` / `Task Count vs Avg Progress` |

In both files, the editor pin and the draft pin fail on main through their precondition: the served text never draws. The en-US pins pass on main by construction, because they pin that nothing changes.

**Ablations.** One per behavioural pin, through `ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor hit is counted, the blob moves, and the restore is proven. Every subject resolves by relative import to `src`, so no build or `dist` leg applies.

| ablation | pin | result |
|---|---|---|
| `NavTree` draws the raw buffer | zh rail rows and headings | red |
| the load opens its leaf from the raw tree | the caption | red: received `Capability Map · 页面` |
| the nav editor is handed the display tree | nav editor and inspector keep the authored label | red |
| nav guard removed | nav entry changed or added in the draft | red, in the unit test and the pillar pin |
| the list draws `w.title` | zh list reads 任务数与平均进度 | red |
| widget guard removed | widget retitled or added in the draft | red, in the unit test and the pillar pin |
| the drafted dashboard's published layer is never read | same pin, served sibling | red: `Unable to find … 任务总数` |
| the widget inspector is handed the served titles | Title input keeps the authored title | red: `Unable to find an element with the display value: Task Count vs Avg Progress` |

The en-US pins have no ablation: the diff adds no English-specific branch to remove.

**Local gates:**

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0. The test project reads every new test file.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over 93 files: exit 0, `Test Files 93 passed (93)`, `Tests 700 passed (700)`. The files are the suites that render or route to the Interfaces pillar, plus the new pins and the `navSurface`, `navItemLabel`, `AppNavCanvas`, `AppNavInspector`, `SourcePageProperties`, `DashboardDefaultInspector`, `DashboardWidgetInspector` and `DashboardPreview` suites.
- eslint on the 8 changed source files: exit 0, 0 errors. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` carries 13 warnings, the same count as on main.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0. The one changeset covers both halves.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations.
- No language-pack key changed, so `check:i18n-keys` does not apply.

A union run on `e242efa` read the component-list draft pin red once, under load. The pin waited on the authored row, which draws as soon as the draft loads, but asserted the served sibling, which draws only after the published-layer read lands. `11191e9` makes the pin wait on the served sibling, the state it asserts. Three isolated runs then passed, and the final union above is on that head.

## Acceptance notes

- **Canvas, unchanged here.** The Studio dashboard canvas (`DashboardPreview`, `DashboardRenderer` without `localized`) translates widget titles through the client bundle, and that pass also runs over a draft. A widget title edited in a draft would therefore draw as the packaged translation on the canvas, while the component list now draws the authored edit. This is a read-only observation, not measured live. Carrier: none.
- **App navigation has no explicit-override rule.** `translateApp` in `@objectstack/spec` applies the bundle by nav id whatever the published label is, while `translateDashboard` follows "The catalog LOSES to an explicit override". A nav label edited and published over a packaged translation would therefore still be served, and drawn by the runtime sidebar and this rail, as the bundle's text. This is a read-only observation, not measured live. Carrier: none.
- **Stale list right after a publish.** The served dashboard list is the metadata store's. A publish triggers that store's refresh (`emitMetadataRefresh`). Until the refresh lands, a widget whose new published title still equals the buffer's would draw the store's previous served title. Not measured.
- **Editor pins are vitest only.** The showcase package is read-only on this backend: the rail offers no Edit toggle there, and the component list offers no remove or drag. The editor pins are measured in the vitest harness only.
- **Backend build artifact.** To boot the card's example, the verify backend checkout needed `packages/connectors/connector-slack` built. Its `dist` was absent, and the showcase config failed to compile without it. That was a build artifact only; no tracked file changed.
